252-4231-5394-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-5394-6968.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

2438-4082-4640--201.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Kemba triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1308-3129-4772-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-3129-4772-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

465-670-1619-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6139.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from exile to the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

997-1303-1769.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-5902-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

240-3967-5470-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

141-4668-7302.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
141-4668-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost reduced by Heliod, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Heliod
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7232.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two tapped lands on the battlefield.
5147-6972-7232.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ignition Team.
When Ignition Team dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3996-4050-6705.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens with flying and a 1/1 Frog creature token
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Spirits and Frog, adding {2}{W}.
When the Spirits and Frog die, Twilight Drover triggers three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2292-4215-5630-6872.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Moss-Pit Skeleton.
When Moss-Pit Skeleton dies, Long Feng and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Moss-Pit Skeleton and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

803-1429-5402-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2350-3054-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2350-3054-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1339-2558-5226-6666.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2558-5226-6666.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Insect.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

880-3470-6662.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

813-961-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Against All Odds.
813-961-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1563-2457-2557-4359.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

813-2628-3542--100.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2} plus enough mana to cycle both cycling cards.
813-2628-3542--100.description:
Activate up to five lands you control, adding at least {2} plus enough mana to cycle both instant / sorcery cards.
Activate an instant or sorcery's cycling ability by paying its cycling cost and discarding it.
Escape Protocol triggers, causing you to pay {1} to blink Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate an instant or sorcery's cycling ability by paying its cycling cost and discarding it.
Escape Protocol triggers, causing you to pay {1} to blink Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the two cycling cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
813-2628-3542--100.notes: The lands must be able to produce {2} plus enough mana of the appropriate types to cycle both instant / sorcery cards in your hand.

1741-4881-5626.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{B}.
1741-4881-5626.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Cloud of Faeries and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cloud of Faeries.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Activated Sleeper and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Cloud of Faeries from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

880-2783-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2783-4871.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers and the creature triggers if it was a Dragon Egg.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Dragon Egg trigger, if applicable, creating a 2/2 Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

372-1922-4823.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1922-4823.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

779-833-2546-4893.description:
Activate Soul of Windgrace's second ability by paying {R} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

583-2440-2634.description:
Cast Sram's Expertise by paying {2}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Sram's Expertise.
Resolve the copy of Sram's Expertise, creating three 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens and casting Rootha without paying its mana cost.
When the Servos and Rootha enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers four times, adding {C}{C}{C} for each Servo you control, plus {C} for each Orc and/or Shaman you control.
Repeat from step 2.

2544-2713-3371.manaNeeded: {4}, plus enough mana to pay for the nonland card's mana cost minus {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
2544-2713-3371.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one instant and/or sorcery card in hand.
2544-2713-3371.description:
Activate Codie by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat as desired, skipping step 2 on the final iteration.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, cast any spell by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

1530-4447-5299.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is five or less.
Assault Suit attached to Second Chance.
1530-4447-5299.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to not sacrifice it due to Assault Suit and take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2105-2857-4068-5147.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Combat Celebrant.
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Combat Celebrant dies, triggering Adarkar Valkyrie, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealling one damage to any target.
Repeat.

651-876-4896.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Task Force.
651-876-4896.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Lightning Greaves ability, attaching it to Task Force.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Task Force, causing the opponent to lose the game due to having zero or less life.

2034-3671-5003-5184.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wily Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Wily Golbin dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Wily Goblin from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Wily Goblin enters the battlefield, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding two mana of any color.
Repeat.

1778-4050-4314-5105.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {W}.
Pawn of Ulamog and Sigil of the New Dawn trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Sigil of the New Dawn trigger, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.
